summary: Iteration 3 (catalogue + visual expansion) — full backend + frontend regression + new-feature verification. BACKEND: 19/19 pytest tests PASSED on public URL (see /app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml). Confirmed: GET /api/jackets returns exactly 10 jackets (ids j01–j10, unique images), genders=[All,Women,Men,Unisex], crafts=[All,Quilting,Ajrakh,Kantha,Kalamkari]. Filters gender=Women&craft=Ajrakh -> only 'The Ajrakh Box Jacket'; gender=Men&craft=Kantha -> only 'The Kantha Work Jacket'; craft=Kalamkari returns the statement jacket; no empty craft categories. /api/crafts returns 4 crafts each with title+image+description. j01 hero+reversible; j10 exists (Kalamkari). /api/dna/result returns 5 tags and 3 recommendations all in j01–j10 with non-empty deterministic reasons; different DNA answers yield different profile ids and different rec sets. Regression: atelier/compute valid=INR 8500/96%/makeable/editorial; invalid bomber+patchwork=42%/not-makeable with fix.silhouette='overshirt'. /api/craft-story omits 'narration'; /api/craft-story/audio/status.configured=true; /api/craft-story/audio streams audio/mpeg >1KB. /api/media/ajrakh_overshirt_men and /api/media/kantha_texture both serve image/*. /api/checkout returns order_id + delivery_estimate_days=production_days+5. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844) golden path all passed: Landing shows 'OLD CRAFT.\nNEW LANGUAGE.' with subtitle 'Indian craft, translated...', both CTAs visible (DISCOVER YOUR DESIGN DNA + EXPLORE THE COLLECTION); scrolling reveals 'CRAFT, REIMAGINED' with all 4 craft cards (quilting/ajrakh/kantha/kalamkari); tapping the Ajrakh card navigates to /catalogue?craft=Ajrakh and filters the grid to j02+j07 (j01 hidden). Catalogue: SHOP+CRAFT filter rows work live — Women+Quilting -> j05+j06 (j01 hidden); cards show ₹ and $ dual price. Product page: j05 (reversible cropped) flip button label = 'ONE JACKET · TWO WORLDS'; j02 (non-reversible Ajrakh overshirt) flip label = 'TURN TO SEE THE CRAFT' — adaptive label works. Product Passport shows Craft/Technique/Material/Maker + PIECE marker. Atelier from Ajrakh product j02: Pattern tab label = 'Block' and options render as Block/Trellis/Panel/Scatter/Vine — craft-vocabulary adaptation confirmed. Made-ability: silhouette=bomber + quilt=patchwork -> 42% with LET AI FIX IT; applying the fix restores 96%. VISUALISE -> CONTINUE TO CHECKOUT -> size M -> BUY MY JACKET -> order-confirmation shown (Order id + 'roughly 26 days'). DNA full flow: 5 questions -> 'Analysing your design DNA' overlay visible -> QUIET ARCHITECT result with 5 attribute pills (Minimal/Architectural/Tactile/Quiet/Contemporary) + 'AI TRANSLATED YOUR TASTE' + 3 recs (j01/j04/j06) each with reason. Craft Story: artisan hero, waveform in audio player, LISTEN TO THE STORY play/pause toggles, passport with piece ID. NO REGRESSIONS FOUND. Only carry-over cosmetic issue: Cormorant TTF fonts still fail OTS parsing on the web preview (Expo's ?unstable_path handler) — falls back to system serif on web, unchanged from iterations 1&2, non-blocking; will render correctly on native builds.

action_items: (Optional/polish, carry-over) Cormorant custom fonts still fail to load on the web preview. Consider hosting via expo-font asset pipeline or a Google Fonts CDN fallback for web only. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/data.py: JACKETS list is clean and modular — 10 items with unique image keys, gender + craft_type populated on every entry; DNA_PROFILES.recommendations all map to valid j01–j10 ids.

backend/server.py: /api/jackets accepts both 'craft' and legacy 'category' query params (craft = craft or category) — nice backward-compatibility. No ObjectId leakage anywhere; all endpoints /api-prefixed; async/await correct.
Frontend atelier initially shows '—' for made-ability for ~200ms while the debounced compute is in-flight — acceptable UX (not an error state), auto-resolves on the first response.
Landing hero crossfade + Ken Burns produces a faint double-image during the ~4.2s crossfade — expected editorial behaviour, not a bug (confirmed in agent-to-agent note).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_-prefixed order document written to Mongo `orders` during test_checkout_returns_order.
